note: Unresolved. The earlier note said the Hudson County Clerk archive shows no Jersey City mayoral contest in 2010. The checker found that the archive index lists elections by date only and shows no municipality. It lists a June 15, 2010 Municipal Runoff Election that the earlier note did not address. This session tried to re-open https://www.hudsoncountyclerk.org/elections-archives/ and the sibling path /election-archives/. Both returned an AWS WAF challenge (HTTP 202, empty body) to curl, and WebFetch returned no content. The NJ Division of Elections page https://www.nj.gov/state/elections/election-information-results.shtml lists only statewide 2010 general and primary results, no municipal results. The cycle of 2013, 2017, 2021 and 2025 is consistent with a four-year term, but no official source opened in this session shows a 2010 mayoral contest or its absence, and the identity of the June 15, 2010 runoff town is not established. The year stays unresolved until an official Hudson County or Jersey City source can be read.
